criteria.purpose: confirm isolated P4 Fork effect; does not grant product acceptance or relabel prior screen
criteria.correctness: all positive SQL/cleanup; two expected negative controls; every wave obeys start/ready/cleanup boundaries
criteria.fork: paired median child-p50 reduction >=3% and >=4/5 improve
criteria.wave_ready: paired median wave-makespan p50 reduction >=3% and >=4/5 improve; otherwise report child vs wave distinction
criteria.cpu_guard: paired median wave Fork process CPU <=+5%, no >=4/5 pairs worse by>5%; excludes SQL/cleanup but includes background engine work
criteria.tails: p50/p95 and >100ms for all stages/waves; retain every run and child

boundaries: root Start includes initial image construction
memory is separate process current ps RSS; forced GC equally at checkpoints; not PSS or physical sharing
P1 fork CPU only; P4 process CPU not per-child exclusive
page_selection: scan initial 256MiB, coalesce adjacent OS pages with any nonzero byte; include initialized state beyond DataEnd
changed_boundary: anonymous reservation plus MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_FIXED only within owned initialized ranges; factory lock and first image build retained
diagnostic_scope: one P1/P4 pair, nested child stage traces and UNDO owner logs; not performance acceptance
comparison: current-source anonymous vs static-page-only; earlier whole-file result is historical, not a third current arm
scope: mechanism isolation: fixed P4 waves, not replacement of completed mixed full-suite screen
wave_contract: 4 start-barrier participants; wait all Fork returns before connect/SQL; join all cleanup before next wave
